components.gap: Composite: GOAL-01 is supplied, but GOAL-02 (precise language and level hypotheses of the stated relationships) and GOAL-03 (actual ordered examples and boundary cases) are only partly supplied, so the composite survey is not complete.

The relationships (stable implies NIP, o-minimal implies NIP, o-minimal does not imply stable, simple plus NIP implies stable) are stated, but not all with their precise language hypotheses: DLO's language is never fixed; 'o-minimal implies NIP' is stated only at theory level with no statement of the structure-to-theory transfer (Knight-Pillay-Steinhorn) that makes 'o-minimal structure' and 'o-minimal theory' interchangeable; and the claim in def:p03-o-minimal that o-minimality is 'strictly stronger than merely being NIP' has no witnessing NIP non-o-minimal ordered example in a stated language.

Only DLO and RCF are named as ordered examples (without argument), and the only boundary case given is DLO's instability. No ordered boundary case shows that an expansion can lose o-minimality or NIP (e.g. an ordered structure with an infinite definable discrete set, or the ordered real field expanded by a predicate for the integers), and no NIP ordered structure that is not o-minimal is given. The text does not claim arbitrary expansions preserve NIP or o-minimality, so that failure condition does not hold, but the required boundary cases are absent.
